arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /bin/bash -lc '
set -Eeuo pipefail
cd /opt/telegram-robot-leads
echo ROOT_TESTS_BEGIN
if test -x .venv/bin/python; then TEST_PY=.venv/bin/python; else TEST_PY=/usr/bin/python3; fi
"$TEST_PY" - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import sys,importlib.util
print("PYTHON",sys.version.split()[0])
for n in ("pytest","telethon","aiosqlite","dotenv"):
 print("MODULE",n,"AVAILABLE",bool(importlib.util.find_spec(n)))
PY
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
if "$TEST_PY" -c "import pytest" 2>/dev/null; then
 "$TEST_PY" -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider --disable-warnings --maxfail=4
else
 echo PYTEST_UNAVAILABLE
 "$TEST_PY" -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" -q
fi
echo ROOT_TESTS_PASS
'

set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /bin/bash -lc '
set -Eeuo pipefail
cd /opt/telegram-robot-leads
echo RUNTIME_HELP_BEGIN
.venv/bin/python scripts/leads_operational_report.py --help
.venv/bin/python scripts/lead_health.py --help
echo FILE_GATES
for p in /root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads/group_allowlist.txt /root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads/approved_users.txt /root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads/growth_model.json /var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json; do
 if test -f "$p"; then stat -c "PRESENT %n %s %a %U" "$p"; else echo "ABSENT $p"; fi
done
echo RUNTIME_HELP_PASS
'
